title: An Act to Exempt a Person Making Electrical Installations in the Person's Existing Bona Fide Personal Abode from Licensing and Permitting Requirements

summary.text: This bill reinstates the exception, inadvertently omitted from Public Law 2017, chapter 198, allowing a person, without first obtaining a license or a permit from the Electricians' Examining Board, to make electrical installations in an existing single-family residence occupied by that person or to be occupied by that person as that person's personal abode that previously existed in the Maine Revised Statutes, Title 32, section 1105, former subsection 5. The installation must conform with the National Electrical Code and other standards adopted by the board.
